packages.label: תִּקּוּן הַכְּלָלִי וְהַצַּדִּיק
packages.label_en: The General Rectification and the Tzaddik
packages.reason: All these concepts share the essential nature of the redemptive/rectifying principle: the Tzaddik (Rashbi), the rainbow of the covenant, the eagle that awakens the mochin, the whitening radiance — all are faces of the single rectifying force that heals the sinews and purifies the blood. They are not linked by cause-and-effect but are all expressions of the same transcendent corrective reality.

packages.label: הַמֹּחִין וְכֵלֵיהֶם
packages.reason: All these concepts share the essential nature of the mochin (the higher mind/brain-consciousness) and its structural extensions: the head, the seven locks of hair (which are the overflow of the mochin), the seven layers of the eye (which are the same as the seven locks), vision, the seven emotional attributes that pass through the mochin, and the diminished state of the mochin (katnut/sleep). They are all facets of the same psycho-spiritual structure — the cognitive-spiritual center of the person — that can be awakened or diminished.

merge_notes.reason: Mochin dkatnut and sleep are the diminished state of the mochin — sharing the same essential nature as the mochin cluster. The text explicitly says the eagle/tzaddik awakens the mochin 'from their dormancy, from the aspect of mochin dkatnut, from the aspect of sleep.' They are the mochin in their lowered state, not a separate domain.

The text explicitly equates eyes and hair via the mochin: 'the seven layers of the eye are the aspect of the seven locks of his head, and they are the aspect of the mochin, for the hairs are the overflow of the mochin.' Eyes and hair are structural expressions of the same mochin-reality. Their 2-node component shares essential nature with the mochin cluster.

packages.label: מַלְכוּת פֶּה — הַבְּגָדִים וְהַדִּבּוּר
packages.label_en: Malkhut of the Mouth — Garments and Speech
packages.reason: All these concepts share the essential nature of malkhut-as-expression: the garments are malkhut (as Rabbi Yochanan called them 'his honors'), kavod is malkhut (Melekh HaKavod), yirat Elohim is malkhut ('if not for the fear of the kingdom'), white garments = tikun of speech = malkhut of the mouth, Torah words (pegs and nails) are the instrument of that holy speech. They all inhabit the domain of the holy Shekhinah/malkhut as she expresses herself through honor, dress, and holy utterance.

merge_notes.reason: The text states explicitly: 'white garments = tikun of speech, which is the aspect of malkhut of the mouth.' White garments and tikun of speech are bechinas of each other and both are bechinas of malkhut. Their 2-node component merges into the malkhut cluster by shared essential nature.

Torah words (as pegs and nails) are the instrument of holy speech. The passage interprets 'he drove it [the peg] downward' as Torah speech without tikun haklali being unable to penetrate, and upward as holy Torah-speech that can. Their essential nature is Torah-as-speech, belonging to the malkhut-speech domain.

packages.label: דַּם נִדָּה וּפְגַם הַבְּרִית
packages.label_en: The Blood of Impurity and the Flaw of the Covenant
packages.reason: All these concepts share the essential nature of spiritual corruption/redness — the stain that separates the Shekhinah from the Holy One. Dam nidda, redness, the stain on the garments, the city of bloodshed, the flaw of the covenant, the flaw of the sinews, and the flaw of the garments are all expressions of the same corrupting force: transgression that activates blood-impurity in the Shekhinah and causes separation (firda). They are not causes of each other — they are all faces of the same polluting reality.

packages.label: שִׁפְחָה בִּישָׁא — הַעֵת רָעָה
packages.label_en: The Evil Maidservant — The Evil Time
packages.reason: These three concepts share the essential nature of the evil counter-force that seizes dominion when the Shekhinah is in her impure state: the evil maidservant (sitra achra's malkhut) who inherits her mistress, the evil woman (opposite of the Woman of Valor), and the evil time (of the 28 times, those times that belong to the evil side). All three are the same malkhut-deSitra-Achra — the evil Shekhinah — viewed from different angles.

packages.label: מָן — פַּרְנָסָה מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם
packages.reason: These three concepts share the essential nature of divinely-given, effortless sustenance: the manna that fell from heaven, 'bread from heaven,' and parnassa without toil. They are all expressions of the same reality — divine nourishment that flows without human effort, as an expression of tikun (the whiteness of the mochin descending as sustenance). They are not a chain of cause-and-effect; they are three faces of the same concept.
